text: カードキーが　ないと　あかないぜ！

structure.jp: カードキーが　ないと

patterns.name: 〜と (condition)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb or ない means 'when this is so, that always follows'. カードキーが　ないと = 'if you don't have the Card Key'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy talk that pushes the statement at the listener. あかないぜ = 'they won't open, I tell ya'.
